payload.claim: The spec's agent notes say `_resolve_stacked_on`'s, `_stack_base_candidate`'s and `run_task`'s docstrings "sit at that limit already," implying all three are at the 10-line `DOCSTRING_LIMIT`. Measured: `_stack_base_candidate` and `run_task` are each exactly 10 lines (at the limit, no existing `prose` hit), but `_resolve_stacked_on` is actually 11 lines and already carries one pre-existing `docstring-length` hit at base. The instruction to trim as lines are added still holds for all three, so this doesn't mislead the builder, but the claim that all three merely "sit at" the limit is imprecise for one of them.
